trailhead.label: Valdaora di Sopra (Oberolang), the board’s start

cautions: Mostly tarred lanes through Valdaora di Sopra and out to the Goste: watch for local traffic.
Near the reservoir the path meets the Pustertal cycle path: keep your dog close for cyclists.
Hay meadows beside the path: keep your dog off them in the growing season.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
